hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Exactly two elements are removed from nums1. After sorting both arrays, the smallest remaining element of nums1 must be one of the first three elements.

hints.title: Candidate Differences
hints.text: Consider the candidate differences diff = nums2[0] - nums1[i] for i in {0, 1, 2}.

hints.title: Subsequence Validation
hints.text: Test each candidate difference in ascending order using two pointers to check if nums2 matches a subsequence of nums1 with shift diff.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting followed by at most three two-pointer validation passes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(n^2) pairs of removed elements takes O(n^3) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Narrow candidate differences down to three possibilities based on the first element of nums2.
